news.title: TCS dips 2%, trades near 6-year low ahead of Q1 results; IT sector in focus
news.snippet:
# TCS dips 2%, trades near 6-year low ahead of Q1 results; IT sector in focus
## The NSE IT index declined nearly 2% in Thursday's early trade, dragged by TCS and Infosys. TCS to announce Q1 results after market hours today.
### TCS to announce Q1 results on Thursday
"Tata Consultancy Services Ltd has informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 09/07/2026, inter alia, to consider and approve i. approve and take on record the audited standalone interim financial results of the Company under Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) for the quarter ending June 30, 2026; ii. approve and take on record the audited consolidated interim financial results of the Company and its subsidiaries under Ind AS for the quarter ending June 30, 2026; and iii. consider declaration of an interim dividend to the equity shareholders," read the release.

Tech Mahindra will announce its audited financial results for Q1 FY27 on July 16, 2026. A board meeting is scheduled for July 16-17 to approve the results. An earnings conference call will be held on July 16 at 5:30 PM IST to discuss the performance with analysts and investors.

![44378667](http://news-images.dhan.co/tech-mahindra-schedules-board-meeting-on-july-16-17-to-approve-audited-q1-fy27-results.jpg)![](https://scanx.trade/assets/svg/news/news-defalut-image.png)

[Tech Mahindra](https://scanx.trade/company/tech-mahindra-ltd) has scheduled the announcement of its audited financial results for the first quarter of FY27 (Q1 FY27) on July 16, 2026. The company will host an earnings conference call the same day at 5:30 PM IST to discuss the standalone and consolidated financial performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

## Board Meeting and Results Announcement
The board of directors is scheduled to meet on July 16-17 to consider and approve the audited financial results. The official announcement of the results will be made on July 16.

## Earnings Conference Call Details
| Parameter | Details |
|-|-|
| Date & Time | Thursday, July 16, 2026, at 5:30 PM IST |
